description: Search live SmartRecruiters job postings by keyword, read every open role from one or more companies, or look up specific posting URLs. No login, cookies, or API key required.

city.description: Exact city name, e.g. London or New York. Leave blank for all cities.
city.title: City

companyIds.description: SmartRecruiters company identifiers, taken from the company's job-board URL (e.g. AveryDennison from jobs.smartrecruiters.com/AveryDennison/...). Required for mode=getJobs.
companyIds.title: Company identifiers

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. us, gb, de, fr. Leave blank for all countries.
country.title: Country code

experienceLevel.description: Filter by the experience level the company assigned to the posting.
enumTitles: No experience (legacy alias for Entry level)
experienceLevel.title: Experience level

includeJobDetails.description: Fetch each posting's detail page for full description HTML, qualifications, apply URL, and referral URL. Adds one request per job.
includeJobDetails.title: Include full job descriptions

jobUrls.description: Posting links such as https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/AveryDennison/744000162663099-role-name, API links, or Company/PostingID pairs. Required for mode=getJobDetails.
jobUrls.title: Job posting URLs or IDs

maxItems.description: Maximum number of job postings to return (1–10000).
maxItems.title: Maximum jobs

mode.description: Choose what to collect. 'searchJobs' searches the public SmartRecruiters job index; 'getJobs' reads complete boards for specific companies; 'getJobDetails' looks up individual posting URLs or IDs.
enumTitles: Get every open role at specific companies
mode.title: Mode

postedWithinDays.description: Only return roles released in the last N days (1–365). Leave blank for any posting date.
postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)

query.description: Words to look for in job titles and descriptions, e.g. 'software engineer' or 'registered nurse'. Used by searchJobs and optionally to narrow getJobs.
query.title: Keyword search

region.description: Region, state, or province name as SmartRecruiters stores it, e.g. California or Bavaria. Leave blank for all regions.
region.title: Region or state

typeOfEmployment.description: Filter by the employment type the company assigned to the posting.
typeOfEmployment.title: Employment type

title: SmartRecruiters Open Roles Search & Lookup Tool
